author: Unity
description:
Learn how to turn one of Unity Studio's ready-made templates into an interactive configurator, without C#.

Unity Studio is a web-based editor designed for industries like manufacturing, automotive, healthcare, architecture, and more to build and share interactive 3D applications fast.

In this tutorial, you’ll see how to use the built-in Configurator template to reuse the template logic and visual for your own product.

You’ll learn how to do the following: 
🔹 Use an existing template to quickly create your own product configurator 
🔹 Reuse the setup to configure your own materials, camera views, and environments.
🔹 Relabel and reconfigure the UI

The result is a complete car configurator that lets you orbit the vehicle, swap wheel sets, change the body paint and interior, and switch environments, all without the complexity of code.
